character: Thermal spa village at 1,450m in the Serre Chevalier valley. Grands Bains du Monêtier — thermal spa with 34°C outdoor pool fed by natural springs. Part of Serre Chevalier (250km). Traditional village atmosphere, stone houses, narrow streets. Gondola to ski area. Quiet, charming.
dining: Savoyard and French restaurants. Spa-oriented dining options.
activities_nearby: Grands Bains du Monêtier (thermal spa, 34°C outdoor pool, sauna, hammam). Serre Chevalier 250km. Snowshoeing, hiking. Via ferrata. Guided ski touring.
